name: Inpweb Ad Spaces – Sell Ads, Banner Manager & Direct Website Monetization
author: Inp-web

sections.description:
🚀 THE REVOLUTION IN DIRECT WEBSITE MONETIZATION

Tired of low payouts, strict rules, and giving away 30% to traditional ad networks? It’s time to take full control of your website’s advertising revenue.

Inpweb Ad Spaces is the ultimate ad manager and banner management tool designed for WordPress creators, bloggers, and entrepreneurs. Our philosophy is simple: You own the traffic, you should keep 100% of the profits.

Whether you want to close manual ad placements via a direct WhatsApp chat or build a fully automated, hands-off monetization machine that makes money while you sleep, this plugin is your all-in-one solution. Stop relying on middlemen and start selling your ad inventory directly to sponsors.

🟢 Lite Version Features (Free forever, insanely powerful)

  • Frictionless WhatsApp Sales: Turn empty ad spots into instant conversations. Advertisers click on an empty banner and are instantly connected to your WhatsApp with a pre-filled, ready-to-buy message.
  • Professional Ad Manager Dashboard: A clean, zero-bloat interface to set up your advertising rates, ad zones, and active banners in minutes.
  • Place Ads Anywhere in Seconds: Use our smart shortcode system [inpweb_espacio tipo="lateral" id="L1"] to inject high-conversion banners into headers, sidebars, or deep within your content.
  • Responsive & Retina Ready: Pre-styled, premium ad boxes that automatically adapt to your WordPress theme and look stunning on any mobile device.
  • Manual Inventory Control: Easily toggle active sponsors on or off, keeping your advertising layout pixel-perfect and organized.

🔥 Pro Features (Automate & Scale Your Revenue)

  • Stripe Autopilot: Allow advertisers to upload their banners, pay securely via Stripe, and reserve ad spaces 24/7. Funds go straight to your bank account automatically.
  • Gemini AI Anti-Competitor Shield (Exclusive): Never let a rival steal your traffic. Our advanced AI analyzes uploaded banners in real-time and automatically blocks your direct competitors from advertising on your site.
  • Professional Analytics & ROI Reports: Track real-time impressions, clicks, and CTR. Generate and export professional Excel reports to prove value and secure long-term renewals from your sponsors.
  • Premium Advertising Formats: Unlock high-impact placements like Full-Width banners and Sticky Ads for maximum visibility and higher pricing tiers.

Ready to maximize your digital revenue? Upgrade to Inpweb Ad Spaces PRO and put your monetization on autopilot.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the inpweb-ad-spaces folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in your WordPress admin area.
  3. Navigate to the Ad Spaces menu in your dashboard to create your first ad zone and set your pricing.
  4. Free Version users: Ensure your WhatsApp number is correctly formatted (with country code) in the Settings panel.
  5. Copy and paste your shortcodes into your pages, posts, or widgets to start selling ads immediately!
sections.faq:
Will this ad manager slow down my website or affect Core Web Vitals?

Not a chance. We built Inpweb Ad Spaces focusing on Conversion and Speed. Unlike bloated advertising plugins, our lightweight code and optimized asset delivery ensure your site remains lightning-fast for both users and search engines.

Is it compatible with my theme and page builders?

Absolutely! The ad slots inherit your site’s native CSS and font styles. Whether you use Elementor, Gutenberg, Divi, or a custom theme, your banners will look like a seamless, premium part of your website.

How does the AI Anti-Competitor Filter actually work?

This is a game-changer for brand protection (PRO feature). You simply define your business niche in the settings. If a competitor tries to buy an ad space to siphon your audience, our AI analyzes their banner text and destination link, blocking the transaction before it even happens.

Do I need a Stripe account to sell ads?

Only if you want the hands-off, automated self-service checkout (PRO feature). For the Free version, all you need is a WhatsApp number to receive advertiser inquiries and close deals manually on your own terms.

Can I show performance metrics to my advertisers?

Yes! The PRO version includes a robust analytics engine. You can download and send professional Excel reports showing exact impressions and clicks, making it incredibly easy to justify your rates and get sponsors to renew.
